shows.title: Stand Up NY Presents: Comedy Killers
shows.description: Stand Up NY Presents: Comedy KillersProduced by Seán MalloryComedy Killers showcases some of the best comedians New York has to offer, alongside top international talent seen in film and television. Featuring a lineup of proven headliners and powerhouse performers, this show highlights stand-up comedy at its highest level. Come experience a night of big laughs and see why these comics are known as the Comedy Killers.Killer LineupHarris Stanton -Comedy CentralBrian Grossi -TMZSubhah Agarwal -NBCT
